rules.description: The scholarship account must be in the student's name, either as an exclusive account or a joint account with a parent.
rules.condition: When applying for pre‑matric Merit‑cum‑Means scholarships.
rules.outcome: Account must be either exclusive or joint with any parent, and must be in the student's name.
rules.evidence_quote: In his/her name either exclusive or joint account with any of his/her parent in case of pre-matric scholarships.

rules.description: A mobile number must be unique for Merit‑cum‑Means scholarships, while for Pre‑Matric and Post‑Matric scholarships a maximum of two applications per mobile number is allowed.
rules.condition: When submitting an application for a scholarship.
rules.outcome: For Merit‑cum‑Means, the mobile number must not be used in any other application; for Pre‑Matric and Post‑Matric, the same mobile number can be used for up to two applications.
rules.evidence_quote: A valid Mobile Number (unique mobile no. for Merit-cum-Means SS; for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric- Maximum two applications per mobile)

rules.description: An email address must be unique for Merit‑cum‑Means scholarships, while for Pre‑Matric and Post‑Matric scholarships a maximum of two applications per email address is allowed.
rules.condition: When submitting an application for a scholarship.
rules.outcome: For Merit‑cum‑Means, the email ID must be unique; for Pre‑Matric and Post‑Matric, the same email ID can be used for up to two applications.
rules.evidence_quote: An Email id (unique email Id. for Merit-cum-Means SS; for Pre-Matric and Post­Matric- Maximum two applications per email Id)

rules.description: Applicants must provide a parents/guardian income certificate issued by the authority designated by the State Government or UT Administration.
rules.condition: When applying for Merit‑cum‑Means based scholarships (as per scheme requirement).
rules.outcome: Submission of the designated income certificate is required.
rules.evidence_quote: Parents/Guardian’s Income certificate issued by the authority designated by the State Government/UT Administration (as per the scheme requirement).
